# Organization Service

## Purpose
The Organization Service manages the multi-tenant organizational structure of the system. It allows for defining organizations, branches, departments, and their relationships, facilitating organizational-level data isolation, resource allocation, and reporting hierarchies.

## Endpoints

| Controller | Endpoint | Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Organization** | `/plugins/Organization/getAllOrganizations` | POST | Lists all organizations. |
| **Branch** | `/plugins/Branch/getAllBranches` | POST | Lists branches of organizations. |
| **Employee** | `/plugins/Employee/getAllEmployees` | POST | Lists organizational staff. |
| **Customer** | `/plugins/Customer/getAllCustomers` | POST | Lists business and individual customers. |
| **Supplier** | `/plugins/Supplier/getAllSuppliers` | POST | Lists suppliers. |

## Dependencies
- **organization-model**: Core data structures.
- **flexicore-boot**: Plugin infrastructure.

## Interesting Features
- **Hierarchical Management**: Organizations can be decomposed into branches and sites for granular management.
- **Unified Customer View**: Supports both `IndividualCustomer` and `OrganizationalCustomer` through a polymorphic API.

## Operation Flow
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Controller as OrganizationController
    participant Service as OrganizationService

    User->>Controller: createOrganization(OrganizationCreate)
    Controller->>Service: createOrganization(OrganizationCreate)
    Service-->>User: Organization Created
```
